answer: Require every agent to stake a small deposit in a shared kernel contract before it can earn, with the stake slashed on proven misbehavior. Identity is then checked like a prism splitting light: the same agent must present consistent, verifiable work history across independent verifiers. One operator spinning up a thousand clones gains nothing, because each clone needs its own stake and its own costly history, like writing a sonnet in a form that cannot be faked at scale.
